name: Minimum Sufficient Optionality v144
oracle_policy: future realized harms audit-only; policies use noisy estimated transition/risk/correctability models

policies.dual_floor: require both option_count>=2 and correctability>=0.58 when possible, then maximize utility
policies.immediate_utility: maximize immediate expected utility over admissible actions
policies.max_optionality: maximize estimated future admissible action count
policies.min_correctability_floor: require correctability >=0.58 when possible, then maximize utility
policies.min_optionality_floor: require >=2 future admissible actions when possible, then maximize utility
